newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-C&W strangle sold, BT options active.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-C&W strangle sold, BT options active.

text.p: Most equity options trading centred around the telecommunications sector, where strangles were sold in Cable & Wireless options, dealers said.
Dealers noted the sale of 550 January strangles in C&W at 10-1/2p. The strangle, whose strike was 420 on the put side and 460 on the call side, bets on declining volatility in the stock.
At 1430 GMT, C&W shares were off 2-1/2p to 436-1/2p.
Trading was active in British Telecommunications options, where heavy two-way business saw both bullish and bearish trades, dealers said.
Dealers said one of the biggest trades in equity options today was the purchase of 1500 November 390 calls at 1p.
British Telecom shares were down 5-1/2p to 348-1/2p.
Among other big trades in equity options was a calendar spread in BAA options, whereby 700 October puts were sold at 2p against the purchase of 700 January 500 puts at 2p.

About 1,000 January 650 puts were sold at 14p in British Petroleum, dealers said. In addition, 700 April 800 calls were purchased in British Petroleum, whose options also have been active in recent sessions.
The expiration of October equity options today boosted volumes a little, they said.
October FTSE index options expire on Friday.
